sql: with c as (select split_part(event_ticker,'-',1) as series, split_part(event_ticker,'-',2) as contest, close_time from mmsell_settlement_meta where close_time > now() - interval '30 days' and split_part(event_ticker,'-',2) <> ''), g as (select contest, count(*) markets, count(distinct series) series_n, count(distinct (close_time at time zone 'UTC')::date) utc_dates from c group by 1), s as (select distinct contest, series from c) select s.series, count(distinct s.contest) straddling_contests, sum(g.markets)/count(distinct s.series) as approx_markets from s join g on g.contest = s.contest where g.utc_dates > 1 group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 20
